title: Neural composite likelihood estimation: simulation based inference for time series
abstract: arXiv:2609.21762v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Simulation based inference (SBI) circumvents the challenge of intractable likelihoods by using a simulator that generates data given parameter values. For instance, neural likelihood estimation (NLE) estimates the likelihood function by training a neural network to perform conditional density estimation on simulated data given corresponding parameters. However such density estimation is only feasible for relatively low dimensional data. We extend the scalability of SBI methods to a higher dimensional problem: long sequences with a complex dependency structure.   We introduce Neural Composite Likelihood Estimation (NCLE). This divides the sequence into smaller, equal-sized batches. Instead of training NLE to estimate the likelihood for an entire sequence, we estimate the likelihood for each batch separately. The product of these forms an approximate composite likelihood (CL), and we perform frequentist inference using methods from the C

translated_title: 神经复合似然估计：面向时间序列的基于模拟的推断
translated_abstract: 基于模拟的推断（SBI）通过使用一个根据参数值生成数据的模拟器，绕过了似然函数难以处理的挑战。例如，神经似然估计（NLE）通过训练神经网络在给定相应参数的模拟数据上执行条件密度估计来估计似然函数。然而，这种密度估计仅对相对低维的数据可行。我们将SBI方法的可扩展性拓展到了更高维度的问题：具有复杂依赖结构的长序列。我们提出了神经复合似然估计（NCLE）。该方法将序列划分为较小的、大小相等的批次。与训练NLE来估计整个序列的似然不同，我们分别估计每个批次的似然。这些似然的乘积构成了近似的复合似然（CL），我们随后使用复合似然领域的方法进行频率派推断。
tldr: 本文提出神经复合似然估计（NCLE），通过将长序列划分为等大小的批次分别估计似然并构成复合似然，成功将基于模拟的推断扩展到具有复杂依赖结构的高维时间序列。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Neural Composite Likelihood Estimation (NCLE), which extends simulation-based inference to high-dimensional time series with complex dependency structures by dividing sequences into equal-sized batches and forming an approximate composite likelihood from separately estimated batch likelihoods.
